description: This summer motorized route accesses Telkwa Pass and Top and Blue Lake. It is most suited to quads and side by sides. Trail starts at 778 m and reaches a max of 1441 m in a beautiful glaciated valley. Nearest recreation site for camping is Jonas Creek, km 22 on the Telkwa FSR. It is possible to travel right through to the recreation sites on the Copper River FSR. There are no designated campsites in the pass.
directions: Approximately 37 kms on the Telkwa Forest Service Road to the parking area in the vicinity of Milk Creek. Can also be accessed from Terrace via Copper River FSR.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - North Coast - Kalum - Cassiar

title: Telkwa Pass
